walkthroughs.body_html:
Fundamentals Of Programming — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fundamentals Of Programming brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fundamentals Of Programming.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

The return address is pushed onto the call stack
